title: Tag
description: A single tag entry in _data/tags.json. Tags are the primary cross-cutting classification axis in d-system.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier. Never rename after first use on a project — it will break queries.

category.description: Grouping axis: client=specific org | platform=named product/service | tech=language/library/tool | domain=knowledge area | methodology=approach/framework | context=situational

description.description: One sentence clarifying scope and distinguishing from similar tags

related.description: IDs of semantically related tags — used for discovery, not hierarchy

deprecated.description: True if this tag is being phased out. Deprecated tags remain valid on existing projects but must not be added to new ones.
